C0803.title: Malicious npm Packages Steal Crypto Keys and API Tokens (SANDWORM_MODE Attack Campaign)
C0803.summary: In February 2026, security researchers disclosed a supply chain worm attack campaign dubbed SANDWORM_MODE, which used at least 19 malicious npm packages to harvest credentials and steal cryptocurrency keys. The packages were distributed via typosquatting and possessed capabilities to exfiltrate system information, access tokens, and API keys, while self-propagating by abusing stolen npm and GitHub
